facility.name: Childrens Lighthouse - Gleannloch
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 20004 CHAMPION FOREST DR, SPRING, TX, 77379

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: A broken sand table was observed outdoors on the playground/active play space designated for children, which contained broken and sharp edges. The sand table was accessible to children and not removed when notified of concern.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Area Maintained According to Manufacturer's Instructions: The splash pad is not being maintained properly, in which the concrete was exposed, which poses a risk to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Area Maintained According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5015(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Four staff files observed did not have the total 24 annual training hours available to evaluate during review of staff files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Two staff observed did not have the pre-employment affidavit completed, and/or available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: The transportation driver(s) did not have the required 2 hour transportation training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: One child's file observed did not have a health statement available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: One child's file observed did not have a food allergy plan available for childcare regulation to review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The Director file was not available for review, as the required files were not maintained properly, and/or put together for Childcare regulation to review during the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The children's nap mats, and/or cots were not labeled in the classrooms observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The Toddler playground and the school-age area contained nails that were exposed, which could result in a tripping hazard, and/or an emergency incident.  The surfacing was torn, in which the playground surface area was exposed, and not maintained per manufacturer's instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One staff file observed obtained an online CPR/First-aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves: One staff in Room 4 did not wash their hands after completing a diaper change of one child. The child was removed from the diaper changing mat and joined the remainder of the classroom. The staff proceeded to pick up another child with the same gloves to check the child's diaper for moist, and/or soiled. Shortly after the staff removed the gloves and placed them in the trashcan and joined the classroom. The staff did not wash their hands, and/or the child's hand after diaper changing task was complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves (26 TAC §746.3415(13))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two staff files did not document the completion of orientation, and/or acknowledging consent to receiving orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled: The employee list was not posted, and/or available for review during the monitor inspection. A number of employees was not provided at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: Five children files observed were not updated. The childcare facility did not update the children files to portray the updated required information by 09/01/2023. The files observed did not include an updated special care needs section, modifications, and/or the child's swimming ability.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(13)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two staff files observed did not include the total 24 training hours. The staff files did not include topics related to growth and development, guidance and discipline, disposing of hazardous materials, and cultural diversity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One infant, 5 months of age did not have a health statement on file, and/or available for review. The infant start date was documented as 04/01/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: One infant, 14 months of age was observed in a walker in the infant 2 classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Crib Mattress Cover - Snug-Fitting and Thin: One infant, 15 months of age was observed sleeping with a large sheet on the crib mattress that did not proportionally fit. The sheet observed was not tight fitting and posed a hazard to children.   The sheet was removed while Licensing staff was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Mattress Cover - Snug-Fitting and Thin (26 TAC §746.2415(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information provided, the caregiver did not utilize good judgement by pulling/yanking a child by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The childcare facility did not report through their portal account the total number of employees who left the previous year by 1/15/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation of Unitary Surfacing Materials - to Manufacturer's Specifications: The pre-k/schoolers playground area observed contained inadequate surfacing underneath the play structure. The green base of the play structure was torn and posed as a tripping hazard to children in care.  The green base of the play structure also contained rocks underneath the ripped surfacing/padding, which was accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation of Unitary Surfacing Materials - to Manufacturer's Specifications (26 TAC §746.4911(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Nap mats observed in Room 7 and Room 8 were not labeled in order to reflect the child that was sleeping on the nap mat during the inspection. The numbers on the cot did not reflect the child that was observed sleeping on the mat.  Staff updated the mats by correcting the number chart to reflect the child present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two staff that were present had expired CPR/First-aid certifications. One staff certification expired 06/19/2023. The second staff file observed expired, 06/12/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Two caregivers in Classrooms 3 and 4 were observed utilizing their personal cell phones while caring for children.  Once the Director was informed of the cell phone use in the classroom, they were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed in Room 3 with 6 infants, 12-18 months of age.   An additional caregiver was added to Room 3 to accommodate ratio. A total of 6 infants were observed, 11-18 months of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One child, four years of age was left unattended for approximately 2 minutes in Classroom 8 of the childcare center. Based on the information obtained the child was being transitioned from the classroom to the outdoor/active play area when the child was left behind during a transition period.  The child was located in the classroom by a staff during a tour of the childcare facility.  Based on the information obtained, a proper name to face check was not conducted to ensure all children were accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three out of ten children records observed did not include a health statement. The health statement was not avaible in the child's file avaible for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The records were not avaible for review during the annual monitor inspection. Training certificates, and/or training topics were not avaible for review per the Health and Safety Audit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The annual certification was dated April 8, 2021. The operation has not reviewed the current CPSC recall list to ensure the child care facility is free of unsafe products.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the director did not ensure that Minimum Standards were maintained when allowing a caregiver to remain in the classroom after being aware that the caregiver was mishandling the children, yelling at the children, and throwing toys around the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement when the caregiver repeatedly handled the children in a rough manner, yelled at the children, and threw toys around the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Caregiver Skills/Needs of Children: 13 incident reports were documented between October of 2021 to November of 2021 addressing concerns of excessive biting within the Toddler classroom.   Based on interviews with parents the effect of  children being bitten caused bruising, broken skin, and redness.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Caregiver Skills/Needs of Children (26 TAC §746.1507(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver in the Toddler classroom had a pending background check. Caregiver was included in ratio in a classroom with 2 caregivers, 12 children, 23 months- 2 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
